title: Question 25
passage:
Should I send the stock count now? The afternoon deliveries aren't in the system yet.
A. The warehouse team already counted this morning's stock. B. Send it at closing, after those deliveries are posted. C. The report goes to the inventory manager.
passageZh:
我現在要送出庫存盤點數字嗎？下午的到貨還沒有登錄到系統。
A. 倉庫團隊已經盤點過早上的庫存。
B. 等那幾筆到貨登錄後，今天結束作業時再送。
C. 那份報表要交給庫存管理主管。
